edits.reason: Say explicitly enumerates the four named points: 'The body runs between the open and the close ... Those four points, open, high, low, and close, are the whole story.' high and low already get markers and the body region is labelled 'body — open to close', but open and close are never marked as discrete points despite being named with equal weight. anatomy exposes open(pt) and close(pt); marker is the correct kind for point anchors. place left/right keeps labels off the body.

The beat is ABOUT where the candle opened and closed: 'Price opened at the bottom and closed at the top, so the buyers were in complete control.' The body region ('full body — buyers in control') only bands the whole body; it does not locate the open/close points the say names. marubozu_bullish exposes open(pt) and close(pt); marker matches the point-anchor type. place below/above sits the labels clear of the body.

Say explicitly references the doji that pauses before the next leg: 'a doji pauses, and the next move begins.' candle_story exposes a pause(pt) anchor that no current show marks (sellers1, buyers1, sellers2 are marked; pause is not). marker on a point anchor is the correct kind; style dot matches the indecision pause, place below keeps the label off the candles near the highs.

noAnchorGaps.concept: the opening top doji that shows indecision at the very start of the sequence (before sellers take control)
noAnchorGaps.quote: A doji at the top shows indecision, then a strong red body hands control to the sellers
noAnchorGaps.why: move candle_story exposes only sellers1, buyers1, sellers2, pause; sellers1 marks where sellers take control (the strong red body), not the prior top-doji indecision. No anchor exists for that opening doji, so it cannot be drawn without inventing one.
